note: The workbook's Datamängd cell is blank, so it names no register and its only scope is the whole source. Its 6 physical occurrences are counted from the workbook the spec writes (_sos_fixtures._write_register): 1 Generell information record (the dataset-version block), 4 DCAT-AP records (the Titel and Beskrivning rows, each in its Svenska and Engelska column; a blank Engelska cell is still delivered, as an unknown value), and 1 Variabelnivå row (LOPNR). There is no Deldatamängder or Kodlista sheet. The SCB rows belong to register 1, outside this slice.
fails_if: `_register_name` (sources/sos_records.py) derives a register name when the Generell information Datamängd cell is blank, so the workbook gets a register scope and selecting it by its source path is refused as naming no selected scope
